decisions.reason: The medical examination light is related enough to the firm's professional lighting and institutional customer base that its in-house R&D can still learn from use experience and improve it, even though it sits in a more specialized niche than the core range.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires remain tightly aligned with the firm's industrial and maritime capabilities, certified production and engineering knowledge, so absorptive capacity strongly supports continued commercialization.

The designer task light is close to existing lighting know-how and benefits from prior market familiarity as a relaunch, but its more design-led and somewhat less strategic position makes it more vulnerable to later range pruning than core professional lines.

The pendant office luminaire fits directly with the firm's workplace and commercial lighting business, and the firm has the technical and customer knowledge to refine and support it within its existing knowledge base.

The premium pendant luminaire line is close to the established offer and, as a multi-model family, gives the firm good scope to absorb customer feedback and improve the product line using its existing R&D and application expertise.
